#include <Wire.h> #include <Adafruit_GFX.h> #include <Adafruit_SSD1306.h> #define SCREEN_WIDTH 128 #define SCREEN_HEIGHT 64 #define OLED_RESET -1 #define OLED_ADDRESS 0x3C Adafruit_SSD1306 display(   SCREEN_WIDTH,   SCREEN_HEIGHT,   &Wire,   OLED_RESET ); const int currentPin = A1; // ACS712 5A = 185 mV/A const float sensitivity = 0.185; void setup() {   Serial.begin(9600);   if (!display.begin(SSD1306_SWITCHCAPVCC, OLED_ADDRESS)) {     Serial.println("OLED not found!");     while (1);   }   display.clearDisplay();   display.setTextColor(SSD1306_WHITE);   display.setTextSize(1);   display.setCursor(20, 25);   display.println("CURRENT TEST");   display.display();   delay(2000); } void loop() {   int raw = analogRead(currentPin);   float voltage = raw * (5.0 / 1023.0);   // ACS712 zero-current output ≈ 2.5V   float current = (voltage - 2.5) / sensitivity;   // Remove small zero-current noise   if (abs(current) < 0.05) {     current = 0;   }   display.clearDisplay();   display.setTextSize(1);   display.setCursor(15, 10);   display.println("EV CURRENT MONITOR");   display.setTextSize(2);   display.setCursor(20, 32);   display.print(current, 2);   display.println(" A");   display.display();   Serial.print("Current: ");   Serial.print(current, 2);   Serial.println(" A");   delay(500); }

IMPORTANT – FINAL DAY FOR REGISTRATION This is a final reminder that today, 15th September 2026, is the LAST DATE for registration for the India Skills Competition 2026–27. We request all eligible students/candidates to make use of this valuable opportunity and complete their registration today without fail The India Skills Competition provides an excellent platform for students to showcase their skills at the national level and an opportunity to represent India at the WorldSkills Competition, Aichi, Japan. The competition covers 63 skill categories across six major sectors: * Manufacturing & Engineering * Information & Communication * Construction & Building * Transportation & Logistics * Creative Arts & Fashion * Social & Personal Services Tamil Nadu has consistently demonstrated excellence in the India Skills Competition, securing 1st place in the South Regional Competition and 2nd place in the India Skills National Competition 2025–26. Building on this achievement, 12 candidates from Tamil Nadu have been selected to represent India at the WorldSkills Competition 2026 in Shanghai, China.   ACTION REQUIRED TODAY All institutions are requested to immediately communicate this opportunity to all eligible students and ensure that they complete their registration on or before today, 15th September 2026. TN Skills Portal for Registration: https://skilldevelopment.tn.gov.in/tnskills/ Resources & Guidelines All resource documents, guidelines, skill categories and other relevant information can be accessed here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rcjtM2L6C5nlH9ZK1FhIt12tO1aG8SMU For assistance regarding registration activities, please contact the TN Skills Team at tnskills@tnsdc.in We look forward to your institution's active participation in identifying, encouraging and supporting the next generation of skilled champions from Tamil Nadu.
